SEND_CONTACT.TITLE: Send contact
SEND_CONTACT.DESCRIPTION: The customer gets a contact card, the same as one sent from the phone.
SEND_CONTACT.HINT: Type at least 2 letters or digits.
SEND_CONTACT.MANUAL: Or type the name and number
SEND_CONTACT.NAME: Name

ERRORS.NOT_EVOLUTION: This inbox is not WhatsApp through Evolution.
ERRORS.NO_RECIPIENT: The conversation has no WhatsApp number.
ERRORS.INVALID_PHONE: One of the numbers is incomplete. Use area code and number.
ERRORS.MISSING_NAME: One of the contacts has no name.
ERRORS.NOT_CONFIGURED: The Evolution key (EVOLUTION_API_KEY) is missing on the server.
ERRORS.EVOLUTION_TIMEOUT: Evolution took too long. Check the conversation before trying again.

SEND_CONTACT.SENT_ONE: Contact sent. It shows in the conversation once WhatsApp confirms.
SEND_CONTACT.SENT_MANY: Contacts sent. They show in the conversation once WhatsApp confirms.

SEND_LOCATION.TITLE: Send location
SEND_LOCATION.DESCRIPTION: The customer gets a map pin that opens in Maps or Waze.
SEND_LOCATION.SEARCH: Search an address or place, or paste a Google Maps link
SEND_LOCATION.NO_RESULTS: No address found. Try adding the city or district.
SEND_LOCATION.SAVED_EMPTY: No saved addresses yet. Ask an administrator to save the company ones.
SEND_LOCATION.SAVED_EMPTY_ADMIN: No saved addresses yet. Search an address and tap "Save to addresses".
SEND_LOCATION.HINT: Tip: you can paste coordinates (-16.68, -49.25) or a Google Maps link.
SEND_LOCATION.NAME: Name the customer sees
SEND_LOCATION.ADJUST_HINT: Click the exact spot on the map to move the pin. Use + and − to zoom.
SEND_LOCATION.APPROXIMATE: The map found the street but not the number: the pin is in the middle of the street. Click the right spot on the map.
SEND_LOCATION.ACCURACY: Browser location accurate to about {meters} m. Check the pin on the map.
SEND_LOCATION.REMOVE_CONFIRM: Remove this address from the saved list?

ERRORS.SEARCH: Could not search right now. Try again.
ERRORS.GEOCODER_UNAVAILABLE: The address search did not answer. Try again or paste the coordinates.
ERRORS.GEOLOCATION: The browser did not share your location.
ERRORS.NOT_EVOLUTION: This inbox is not WhatsApp through Evolution.
ERRORS.NO_RECIPIENT: The conversation has no WhatsApp number.
ERRORS.INVALID_COORDINATES: The place coordinates are not valid.
ERRORS.MISSING_NAME: Give the address a name to save it.
ERRORS.TOO_MANY_LOCATIONS: Limit of 50 saved addresses. Remove one first.
ERRORS.NOT_CONFIGURED: The Evolution key (EVOLUTION_API_KEY) is missing on the server.
ERRORS.EVOLUTION_TIMEOUT: Evolution took too long. Check the conversation before trying again.

FORWARD.TITLE: Forward message
FORWARD.VIA: Sent from the {inbox} inbox, the one of the open conversation.
FORWARD.SEARCH: Search a contact or group by name or phone

ERRORS.DEFAULT: Could not forward the message. Try again.
ERRORS.MISSING_RECIPIENT: This contact has no phone or email to receive from the {inbox} inbox.
ERRORS.NOTHING_TO_FORWARD: This message has no text or attachment to forward.

ERRORS.NOT_FOUND: Could not find this message on WhatsApp to react.
ERRORS.NOT_EVOLUTION: This inbox is not WhatsApp through Evolution.
ERRORS.NOT_AVAILABLE: You cannot react to this message.
ERRORS.NOT_CONFIGURED: The Evolution key (EVOLUTION_API_KEY) is missing on the server.
ERRORS.EVOLUTION_TIMEOUT: Evolution took too long to answer. Check WhatsApp before trying again.

EDIT.TITLE: Edit message
EDIT.DESCRIPTION: The text changes here and on the customer's WhatsApp, marked as "Edited". WhatsApp only allows editing up to 15 minutes after sending.

ERRORS.NOT_EDITABLE: You can only edit text you sent, up to 15 minutes later.
ERRORS.INVALID_TEXT: Write the new text (up to 4096 characters).
ERRORS.NOT_FOUND: Could not find this message on WhatsApp to edit.
ERRORS.NOT_EVOLUTION: This inbox is not WhatsApp through Evolution.
ERRORS.NOT_CONFIGURED: The Evolution key (EVOLUTION_API_KEY) is missing on the server.
ERRORS.EVOLUTION_ERROR: WhatsApp did not accept the edit. After 15 minutes the message can no longer be edited.
ERRORS.EVOLUTION_TIMEOUT: Evolution took too long to answer. Check WhatsApp before trying again.

DETAILS.TIMEOUT: WhatsApp took too long to answer.
DETAILS.INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND: the instance is not loaded in Evolution.
DETAILS.LOGGED_OUT: WhatsApp logged the device out of the instance.
DETAILS.RATE_LIMIT: too many messages in a short time; WhatsApp held the sending.

NUMBER_NOT_ON_WHATSAPP.TITLE: Number without WhatsApp
NUMBER_NOT_ON_WHATSAPP.TEXT: The message was not sent: this number has no WhatsApp. Check the area code and the extra 9 digit on the contact.

NOT_SENT.TITLE: Message not sent
NOT_SENT.TEXT: Evolution could not deliver the message to WhatsApp. Check that the inbox WhatsApp is connected and send it again.

DISCONNECTED.TITLE: WhatsApp disconnected
DISCONNECTED.TEXT: The {inbox} inbox lost its WhatsApp connection. Nothing goes out or comes in until the QR code is scanned again in Evolution.

ALREADY_CONNECTED.TITLE: WhatsApp already connected
ALREADY_CONNECTED.TEXT: The {inbox} inbox is already connected to WhatsApp.

INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND.TITLE: Instance not found
INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND.TEXT: Evolution could not find the {inbox} instance. Check its name in Evolution.

IMPORT_STARTED.TITLE: Message import
IMPORT_STARTED.TEXT: Started importing old messages. Please wait...

IMPORTED.TITLE: Import finished
IMPORTED.TEXT: {count} messages imported. Refresh the page to see them.

IMPORT_FAILED.TITLE: Import not finished
IMPORT_FAILED.TEXT: Could not import the old messages.

QR_LIMIT.TITLE: QR code limit
QR_LIMIT.TEXT: No QR code attempts left. To get a new one, send init in this conversation.

COMPOSER.MIC_ERROR: Could not use the microphone. Check the browser permission.

SELECT.NOT_FORWARDABLE: Private notes and deleted messages are not forwarded.

FORWARD_MANY.TITLE: Forward {count} messages
FORWARD_MANY.SENT: {count} messages forwarded to {name}. | {count} message forwarded to {name}. | {count} messages forwarded to {name}.
FORWARD_MANY.PARTIAL: {failed} of {total} sends failed. Check the conversations.

EMPTY.MEDIA: No photos, videos or audio yet.
EMPTY.LINKS: No links in the loaded messages.

FILE_VIEWER.MOBILE_PDF: On a phone, the PDF opens in the device viewer.

REASONS.UNSUPPORTED: This file type cannot be viewed here. Use Download.
REASONS.TOO_BIG: File too large to view here (Excel up to 5 MB; Word and PowerPoint up to 10 MB). Use Download.
REASONS.NOT_PUBLIC: Word, Excel and PowerPoint only open here on the public Chatwoot address. In the test environment, use Download.
REASONS.MISSING: The file is no longer available.
REASONS.NO_ACCESS: You do not have access to this file in Microsoft 365.
REASONS.LOAD: Could not open the file right now. Try again or use Download.
